timeline.text: One screen. Your phones. And that friend who says they don't get competitive.
timeline.title: ONE SCREEN. ZERO PEACE.
timeline.label: BRING YOUR FRIENDS

timeline.text: We set out to build a party racer. The cars took that personally.
timeline.title: A PERFECTLY SENSIBLE IDEA.
timeline.label: THEN THE CARS GOT INVOLVED

timeline.text: Built from reference sheets. Rebuilt until the wheels finally got the message.
timeline.title: BUILT. BROKEN. REBUILT.
timeline.label: FROM REFERENCE SHEETS TO RIVALRY

timeline.text: Then we gave a sensible car some deeply unreasonable roads.
timeline.title: DEEPLY UNREASONABLE ROADS.
timeline.label: GRAVITY HAS ENTERED THE CHAT

timeline.text: Take the risky line. Find your grip. Make the next corner somebody else's problem.
timeline.title: TAKE THE RISKY LINE.
timeline.label: THERE IS ALWAYS ANOTHER CORNER

timeline.text: No installs. Just open a browser, scan in, and race together.
timeline.title: YOUR PHONE IS THE CONTROLLER.
timeline.label: OPEN A BROWSER. SCAN IN. RACE.

timeline.text: Joystick Jammers. Bring your friends. Leave your dignity at the starting line.
timeline.title: JOYSTICK JAMMERS
timeline.label: BRING YOUR FRIENDS. LEAVE YOUR DIGNITY.
